nom: TATCHA The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin report the oil does not add greasiness and one says it actually leaves skin looking less oily, though one user notes skin feels 'kind of oily' after use.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers describe the cleanser as hydrating and non-stripping, calling it 'the best makeup remover for DRY skin' and reporting no tightness or dryness after rinsing, though one dry-environment reviewer felt a dry sensation after rinsing.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers who feared an oil would worsen oiliness report the opposite: skin feels balanced, soft and not greasy after use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive and reactive-skin reviewers repeatedly report no irritation, no stinging in the eyes and no breakouts, with one exception reporting the product made her skin itchy.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (ages 47 to 78 mentioned) describe the product as gentle, non-drying and part of a long-term routine, with some crediting it for skin that looks smooth or unwrinkled.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal-to-dry skin reports it cleans without stripping needed hydration.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers report smooth, radiant-looking skin and long-term satisfaction; one attributes an unwrinkled appearance partly to years of use, though this is anecdotal and not tied to any active ingredient claim.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including those in dry climates, report skin feels hydrated, soft or moisturized after rinsing; a couple mention a dry sensation or feeling that the formula isn't cleansing enough on its own.
concerns.redness: Sensitive-skin reviewers report no irritation or redness even around the eyes, with no dissenting reports of increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers describe the cleanser as non-stripping and barrier-friendly, saying it removes makeup 'without over-stripping the skin barrier' or drying out skin.
concerns.spots: Not enough reviewer language specifically distinguishes dark spots or pigmentation from general aging concerns to report separately.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and calm, soft skin after use; one dissenting review describes ongoing itchiness rather than breakouts, and no reviewer reports cystic acne from this product.
concerns.oiliness: Several oily/combination-skin reviewers report skin feels balanced or less oily after use, but one reviewer explicitly notes skin gets 'kind of oily' afterward, wondering if she isn't rinsing correctly.

extraits.texte: This is the only tatcha product that makes my skin itch not a rash just itchy I don't have rosacea or anything like the other low reviews but this was the only thing I added to my skincare routine and it's like it caked my face in an itchy film I even followed the quotdouble cleansequot instructions emailed to me exactly as the routine said I don't wear foundation maybe you need to wear makeup to need it My skin itched so bad when I was using it As soon as if wash it off it would stop itching

extraits.titre: Wish I didn't love Tatcha products because of the price
extraits.texte: I have combination skin that feels dry underneath and oily on top. I use powder papers to mop my face during the day because it gets so oily. I was afraid oil cleanser would make my skin oilier but somehow this did NOT - it actually makes it seem less oily and less dry at the same time. This is so expensive, I bought Peach & Lily oil cleanser attempting to find a less expensive alternative, and there's no comparison. I will just have to bite the bullet and spend the $ on this. I rarely write reviews, but I love this stuff.

extraits.titre: I will never be without this!
extraits.texte: Ive been using this oil cleanser for years on my sensitive acne prone dry skin and it couldnt be better A luxuriously gentle and effective cleanser Saw a friend after a few years amp she was impressed with no wrinkles! I dont use retinol or other products but have used this for many years now so I attribute my smooth skin to this! Im 47

extraits.titre: No breakouts with Acne Prone Skin - Perfect First Cleanse
extraits.texte: I was nervous about using an oil cleanser with acne prone skin, but it rinses clean and has not caused any breakouts. My skin feels soft and calm, not tight or irritated. It takes off my makeup really well (even my mascara) and has been the perfect first cleanse. It's super gentle and feels moisturizing, which is good because I follow with a second cleanser. Highly recommend!

I have very sensitive skin and have been using the camellia cleansing oil for a couple years I love it because it cleans my makeup off doesnt strip the moisture from my face or leave a weird grimy feeling like cream cleansers tend to do Will continue to repurchase!!

extraits.titre: The best makeup remover for DRY skin!
extraits.texte: This product changed my skin care game in 2017 I have used it every night since then It melts your makeup off even mascara! Leaves your skin smooth and hydrated Bonus it removes face glitter and can help remove stubborn false eyelashes
It works great! My one complaint would be that my skin gets kind of oily after using but maybe I'm just not washing it off right
